comment: The AI ladder's players (D317): a name, an AI kind and its parameters. A name is permanent: never edit the kind or params of a player that has played (the ladder keys results by name AND config hash, so an edit would split it in two); add a new name instead. Anchors are stock Forge and are always in the pool; forge-default is fixed at 1500. tools/ai-ladder/kinds.ts lists the kinds and their parameters. `ai-ladder.sh tune` appends here and never overwrites.

players.name: forge-default
players.note: Forge 2.0.14's AI, Default.ai profile. The rating scale's zero: 1500.

players.name: forge-reckless
players.note: Reckless.ai; D311 measured it about +10 points over Default on the cube pairs.

players.name: search-v1
players.note: The game's `MtgTable --ai-policy search` seat with its defaults: D310's outlet policy plus D312's determinized rollout search (D312-D314).
